name: com.nova.starter-assets
description: A ready-to-play third-person character controller in C#: WASD / arrow keys move relative to the camera, Left Shift sprints, Space jumps, with acceleration, smooth turning, gravity and jump/fall timeouts. Put ThirdPersonController on a GameObject with a Character Controller and point a Follow Camera at it. Animator parameters Speed, MotionSpeed, Grounded, Jump and FreeFall are set when they exist. Also a drivable car (CarController on Wheel Colliders: throttle, brake then reverse, speed-sensitive steering, handbrake, flip back) and a ragdoll target that falls where it is shot (RagdollTarget + RagdollShooter).
